POST /images/edits.reason: one image plus a prompt through the operator's ComfyUI edit workflow; file_id or multipart; mask and image_url refused

POST /images/variations.reason: n submits of the operator's ComfyUI variation workflow, one seed each; square PNG in, no caller prompt; dall-e-2 accepted as the spec's model name

POST /videos.reason: the operator's ComfyUI t2v or r2v workflow; multipart image or a stored file_id; image_url refused

GET /videos.reason: rows on the data volume that have not passed expires_at

DELETE /videos/{video_id}.reason: deletes the stored row and the MP4

DELETE /models/{model}.reason: served as a documented no-op: nothing here is a fine-tune, so `deleted` is always false, for any id (decision 2026-09-17 — a harness walking the Models API should not break on it). It cannot delete anything; that is pinned by test_delete_never_deletes_anything

POST /moderations.reason: served and spec-shaped, and it classifies nothing: every result is flagged=false with zero scores (decision 2026-09-18 — build the route, decide nothing, document it so nobody believes it works). The real gate is #121, required before any external user.

POST /audio/speech.reason: binary audio body (application/octet-stream in the spec); non-streaming only; mp3|opus|flac|wav|pcm, speed 1.0, configured voices (#139)

POST /audio/transcriptions.reason: non-streaming; response_format json|text; wav|mp3|flac|ogg by bytes (#139)

POST /responses.reason: over the Chat core; function, web_search and image_generation tools; store default true; background (non-stream) with retrieve/cancel; prompt/include refused (#146)

GET /responses/{response_id}.reason: stored responses, 30-day retention; stream replay refused (#146)

POST /conversations.reason: items (message, function_call, function_call_output; max 20) and metadata (Phase 4, #146/#142)

DELETE /conversations/{conversation_id}.reason: deletes the conversation and its items (Phase 4, #146/#142)

POST /responses/{response_id}/cancel.reason: background responses only; idempotent on terminal status

POST /responses/input_tokens.reason: exact count from the model's usage for a one-token prefill; personality refused

POST /responses/compact.reason: configured-model summary in one compaction item; encrypted_content is signed, not encrypted

POST /responses?beta=true.reason: the same handler as POST /responses; ?beta=true changes nothing (tests/test_responses_beta_aliases.py)

GET /responses/{response_id}?beta=true.reason: the same handler as GET /responses/{response_id}; ?beta=true changes nothing (tests/test_responses_beta_aliases.py)

DELETE /responses/{response_id}?beta=tru.reason: the same handler as DELETE /responses/{response_id}; ?beta=true changes nothing (tests/test_responses_beta_aliases.py)

POST /responses/{response_id}/cancel?bet.reason: the same handler as POST /responses/{response_id}/cancel; ?beta=true changes nothing (tests/test_responses_beta_aliases.py)

POST /responses/compact?beta=true.reason: the same handler as POST /responses/compact; ?beta=true changes nothing (tests/test_responses_beta_aliases.py)

GET /responses/{response_id}/input_items.reason: the same handler as GET /responses/{response_id}/input_items; ?beta=true changes nothing (tests/test_responses_beta_aliases.py)

POST /responses/input_tokens?beta=true.reason: the same handler as POST /responses/input_tokens; ?beta=true changes nothing (tests/test_responses_beta_aliases.py)

POST /audio/translations.reason: transcribe with the configured STT, then translate to English with the chat model; json|text

POST /files.reason: storage only (files_api.py): bytes on the data volume, batch files expire after 30 days, others kept until deleted; tests/test_files_api.py; purpose evals refused (not representable in OpenAIFile, out of scope #142)

GET /files.reason: storage only (files_api.py): bytes on the data volume, batch files expire after 30 days, others kept until deleted; tests/test_files_api.py

GET /files/{file_id}.reason: storage only (files_api.py): bytes on the data volume, batch files expire after 30 days, others kept until deleted; tests/test_files_api.py

DELETE /files/{file_id}.reason: storage only (files_api.py): bytes on the data volume, batch files expire after 30 days, others kept until deleted; tests/test_files_api.py; a real delete of the row and the bytes

GET /files/{file_id}/content.reason: storage only (files_api.py): bytes on the data volume, batch files expire after 30 days, others kept until deleted; tests/test_files_api.py; raw bytes, application/octet-stream

POST /embeddings.reason: served by the configured embeddings backend; required model and string/string-array input are validated, token-array input is refused by name because token ids are tokenizer-specific, and output batch indexes, vectors, and usage are checked before returning

GET /artifacts/{artifact_id}.reason: Chord artifact retrieval; not an OpenAI operation

GET /health.reason: Chord deployment readback; not an OpenAI operation
